verdict.rationale: Alloy publicly serves a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at https://developer.alloy.com/public/openapi/alloy.yaml, covering sandbox and production servers, and per-page .md mirrors carry per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments. That is a downloadable machine-readable spec. The main caveat is discoverability: the docs UI disables the download button, so users must know the direct URL or find it through llms.txt. Missing for 10: a UI-linked or advertised spec download, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the file is complete and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin (servers sandbox.alloy.co/v1 and api.alloy.co/v1).
